old_rules.probability_intervals: Bonferroni Wilson over all distinct selected physical/SNR/stratum keys; approximate simultaneous coverage
old_rules.uncertainty_envelope: Source bootstrap 97.5% plus physical probability box. This is a conservative diagnostic envelope, not an exact finite-sample joint confidence interval.
old_rules.state_extreme_safeguard: Enlarge source-bootstrap margins with Wilson using effective independent n=100 sources, each source contributing its mean of three indicators. Zero events never prove zero true probability.
old_rules.state_test: Every gray/prefix/full/corrupted-or-unmodelled frequency discrepancy envelope lies strictly inside +/-0.125. Excluding the entire equivalence band is FAIL; otherwise unresolved is UNCERTAIN.
old_rules.ranking_test: All distinct-wire pairs have the same resolved sign in actual and predicted intervals, or both intervals lie wholly within +/-0.002. At least one distinct-wire pair must have a resolved sign. Identical-wire pairs are structural identities, not independent validation.
old_rules.error_vs_gain_test: For each resolved distinct-wire contrast, upper absolute actual-minus-predicted error envelope is strictly below 0.5 times the smaller conservative positive magnitude lower bound of actual/predicted gain. Practical ties do not support a gain claim.
old_rules.quality_population: Same 100 development sources, noiseless frozen selected-state Q; calibration means cannot replace paired-source Q. Development Q is diagnostic only and never selects or refines policies.
old_rules.uncertain_action: Deliver and stop; do not extend N2048, add sources, change the metric, or reselect policies.
